title: Oxylabs Web Scraping Tools
summary: This module provides a suite of tools for web scraping using the Oxylabs Realtime API, enabling extraction of data from Amazon product pages, Amazon search results, Google search results, and any specified website URL.

nodes.label: Scrape Amazon Product
nodes.title: Amazon Product Scraper
nodes.description: Scrapes detailed information from specific Amazon product pages using the Oxylabs Realtime API, returning structured data.

nodes.label: Scrape Amazon Search Results
nodes.title: Amazon Search Scraper
nodes.description: Retrieves search results from Amazon based on a query, utilizing the Oxylabs Realtime API to bypass common scraping challenges.

nodes.label: Scrape Google Search Results
nodes.title: Google Search Scraper
nodes.description: Performs Google searches and scrapes the results, providing access to up-to-date information via the Oxylabs Realtime API.

nodes.label: Scrape Any Website URL
nodes.title: Universal Web Scraper
nodes.description: Scrapes content from any specified URL using the Oxylabs Realtime API, offering a versatile solution for general web data extraction.

nodes.label: Oxylabs Realtime API
nodes.title: Oxylabs Realtime API
nodes.description: External API service provided by Oxylabs for real-time web scraping, handling proxy management and bypassing anti-bot measures.

nodes.label: Environment Variables
nodes.title: Oxylabs Credentials
nodes.description: Provides Oxylabs API credentials (username and password) from environment variables for secure tool authentication.

nodes.label: User Interaction
nodes.title: Package Installation Prompt
nodes.description: Prompts the user to install the 'oxylabs' Python package if it's missing, ensuring necessary dependencies are met for tool functionality.

groups.label: Oxylabs Scraping Tools
groups.title: Oxylabs Scraping Tools
groups.description: A collection of tools designed to perform various web scraping tasks using the Oxylabs Realtime API, including Amazon product/search and Google search scraping, as well as universal website scraping.
